title: Cardinal Billing Account Late Fees and Member Tenure: Loyalty Rate
content:
**Clause.** A loyalty rate applies to the late fee charge of a Cardinal Billing Account and multiplies it:

- **0.50** when no notice of cancellation for nonpayment was mailed on the account in the last 12 whole months and the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's original inception date is at least 60 whole months before the charge date;
- **0.75** when no such notice was mailed in the last 12 whole months and the inception date is at least 24 but under 60 whole months before the charge date;
- **1.00** in every other case.

A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the charge date, counted on calendar months. Tenure is counted in whole months from the original inception date shown on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy (the date the policy first began with Cardinal) to the charge date. Notices are the notices of cancellation for nonpayment recorded on the billing account.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Notice of cancellation in the last 12 whole months | Whole months from inception to the charge date | Loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| None | 60 | 0.50 |
| None | 59 | 0.75 |
| None | 24 | 0.75 |
| None | 23 | 1.00 |
| One or more | 140 | 1.00 |
| One or more | 30 | 1.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A charge figured at $12.00 on an account with no notice in the last 12 whole months and a policy incepted 75 whole months before the charge date is multiplied by 0.50.
